key_encoding: isect_id(u64) = image_id << (32+tile_n_bits) | tile_id << 32 | f32bits(depth); tile_id = tile_y*tile_width + tile_x; tile_n_bits = bits_for_count(tile_width*tile_height), image_n_bits = bits_for_count(I). SXT does not support int64 → stored split into int32 lo (low 32 bits = the depth f32 bits reinterpreted) and hi (high 32 bits = image|tile) (D3).
note: Dedicated to tied keys (hand-synthesized input, no random numbers, AABB path — 07 Correction 2). Within a group sharing the same (image,tile,depth bits) key, flatten_ids_sorted preserves emit order (ascending Gaussian index) — a non-stable sort mismatches this golden bit-for-bit. I=1 → covers the image_n_bits=0 edge. All tensors are compared exact (int/bit).
sort_contract: Ascending **stable** sort on the ulong(u64) key (the sort contract, 03). The golden is np.lexsort((lo,hi)) — the equivalence baseline is the CPU std::stable_sort(ulong key). torch.sort is not used (stability is not guaranteed).
